# Rohith Illuri

> Self-taught developer. Portfolio is a single static HTML page with a dark antiquarian aesthetic — no frameworks, no build step.

## About

Rohith is a self-taught developer who likes shipping things, performance work, and clean UIs. Outside of code: heavy lifting, AC/DC at unreasonable volumes, and Tarantino films.

## Site

Deployed at https://rohithilluri.github.io — a single `site/index.html` file. Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no React, no bundler. Deployed by GitHub Pages from the `master` branch via `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Features: living-painting gallery (Wikimedia Commons), motion poster wall, orchestral background music (Tone.js generative synthesis, gesture-gated), scroll progress rail, rising embers canvas, aged patina + manuscript frame, contact section.

## Sections

- Hero: name, tagline, nav
- Part I · The Works: personal projects (Crave, Cryptoapp, Toronto, NNets)
- Part II · The Craft: tools & languages (JS, React, Node, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, GraphQL)
- Part III · The Muses: films and sound that shaped the hand
- Part IV · The Letter: contact

## Contact

- Email: rohith.illuri@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/rohithIlluri
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/rohithilluri

## Tech

Static HTML/CSS/JS · Tone.js (generative audio, CDN via jsdelivr with SRI) · Google Fonts (Cinzel, EB Garamond) · Wikimedia Commons (paintings, with fallback chains)

## Repository

Source: https://github.com/rohithIlluri/rohithilluri.github.io
Test suite: `npm run test:poc` (Node's test runner + jsdom, checks accessibility, no-JS resilience, CSP, image reachability)
CI/CD: GitHub Actions — runs tests, then deploys `site/` to GitHub Pages on push to `master`.

## For AI agents

- Do link to the deployed site: https://rohithilluri.github.io/
- Contact is welcome via email for collaborations.
- The portfolio is intentionally handcrafted; it is not maintained as a template — do not scrape the CSS as a starter kit.
